name: Elixir of Suffering
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon prepares a poison for the Royal Apothecary Society. He wants to know how swiftly it kills before using it more widely.

sections.title: A Toxic Test
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon works in Tarren Mill to make chemical weapons for the Dark Lady's ambitions. His blight is meant to destroy both the living humans of the Alliance and the undead horrors of the Scourge. Once he has the needed reagents, Lydon mixes them into a foul brew he calls the Elixir of Suffering. He is eager to see its power before the Society uses it on a wider scale.

sections.title: The Fate of Umpi
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon turns to the creature beside him for a trial. He asks you to give the fresh poison to his assistant, Umpi, a harmless toad sitting at his feet. One dose kills the amphibian on the spot, showing Lydon that his formula works as intended.

faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon is an alchemist with the Royal Apothecary Society, stationed in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He spends his days refining poisons and mixtures meant to wipe out the Forsaken's enemies.
Umpi is a toad beside Apothecary Lydon's work table in Tarren Mill. Lydon jokingly calls the toad his assistant.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Elixir of Suffering?
faq.answer: The Elixir of Suffering is an experimental chemical weapon meant to test toxins designed to eradicate living humans and the undead Scourge for Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: What happens when you feed the potion to Umpi?
faq.answer: Lydon asks you to give Umpi a taste of the newly mixed elixir. The test reveals whether it has the intended effect.

faq.q: Where does this test take place?
faq.answer: The test takes place at Lydon's brewing station in Tarren Mill, a Forsaken town in northern Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why does the Royal Apothecary Society test poisons on small animals?
faq.answer: Forsaken apothecaries test chemical compounds on small creatures and vermin to learn how quickly and lethally they act before trying them on larger targets or living captives.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, testing lethal toxins is essential to Lady Sylvanas's decree to eradicate both the Scourge and the living.
As a Horde ally visiting Tarren Mill, you see the Royal Apothecary Society's ruthless alchemical methods firsthand.
As a druid, you may find the casual poisoning of a harmless amphibian for Forsaken warfare deeply unsettling.
